rag.title: Knowledge Base Indexing
rag.description: Select specific ClickUp documents to index. All their subpages will be included.

docs.title: Documents to index
docs.hint: Paste the doc ID from the ClickUp URL and press Enter
docs.addFirst: Add at least one document ID above.
docs.duplicate: This ID is already in the list.

status.notIndexed: No index found. Add doc IDs and run indexing.

test.title: Test Knowledge Assistant
test.description: Ask a question to verify the indexed content is being retrieved correctly.
test.empty: Ask a question to test the index.
test.error: Error getting response. Check server logs.

selector.title: User Story Workspace
selector.subtitle: Select an idea to work on its User Story with the AI.
selector.empty: No ideas match the current filters.

chat.title: Chat with the PO assistant
chat.welcome: Let's work on the User Story for "{{title}}". Generate the initial draft when you're ready.
chat.welcomeExisting: "{{title}}" already has a saved User Story. You can use it or regenerate.
chat.storyGenerated: I've generated the initial User Story draft. Tell me what you'd like to adjust — I can modify any section, add acceptance criteria, change the focus, etc.
chat.generateError: Could not generate the User Story. Please try again.
chat.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
chat.placeholder: Request changes, add context, refine criteria…
chat.hint: Shift + Enter for new line · Enter to send

discard.title: Discard idea
discard.subtitle: Provide a reason for discarding this idea. It will be visible to the author.
